newsitem.title: Australia: Rugby league-ABC wins Super League radio rights.
newsitem.headline: Rugby league-ABC wins Super League radio rights.

text.p: The Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) announced on Wednesday it had won exclusive national radio rights to broadcast Super League matches from this year.
The ABC last week became the second free-to-air carrier for televised Super League matches after Kerry Packer's Channel Nine won the rights to air Monday night matches.
Regional radio broadcasters with existing deals with clubs outside New South Wales will still be able to broadcast matches in their local areas.
